Suppose the existing class constants admit the strict-slack clause in \(\mathrm{def:fixed	ext{-}support	ext{-}lower	ext{-}family}\). Then the family \(\mathfrak F_{\mathrm{LB}}\) belongs to \(\mathcal M_s\) for all sufficiently small \(h\). Indeed, \(H_p\equiv\overline A_0\), while \(\operatorname{sym}(B_t\overline A_0^{-1})\) has first block \[ egin{pmatrix}1&4t/9\4t/9&1-8t/9\end{pmatrix},\qquad \det=1-8t/9-16t^2/81,\] so its smaller eigenvalue crosses zero transversally at \(t_\star=(9/4)(\sqrt2-1)\). The perturbation and its gradient vanish near \(\partial U_j\), and strong convexity plus boundary equality imply \(
abla\varphi_q^{(j)}(U_j)=B_{t_{-}}U_j\); hence every \(\mathbf P_j\) and \(\mathbf P^+\) has exactly the common supports \(D_p=\overline A_0\Omega\) and \(D_q=B_{t_{-}}\Omega\). Moreover, \[\lVert D^2(\varphi_q^{(j)}-\varphi_q^+)Vert_\infty\lesssim	heta,\qquad \lVert\varphi_q^{(j)}-\varphi_q^+Vert_{C^{s+2}(\Omega)}\lesssim	heta h^{-s}=a.\] The identity \[f_q^{(j)}(
abla\varphi_q^{(j)}(u))= rac{\lvert\Omegavert^{-1}}{\det D^2\varphi_q^{(j)}(u)}\] yields \(\lVert f_q^{(j)}-f_q^+Vert_\infty\lesssim	heta\) and \(\lVert f_q^{(j)}Vert_{C^s(D_q)}\le\lVert f_q^+Vert_{C^s(D_q)}+Ca\). Choosing \(Ca<\eta/2\) verifies positivity, density and potential norms, ellipticity, charts, and curvature uniformly without adding an assumption. Transversality gives \[\gamma_{pq}(\mathbf P^+)\ge c_0	heta,\qquad \gamma_{pq}(\mathbf P_j)\le-c_1	heta<0,\] because on \(\lVert u-u_jVert_2\le h/3\), \(D^2\varphi_q^{(j)}(u)=B_{t_\star+	heta/2}\). Thus every component is in the composite null and the alternative has separation \(ho\asymp	heta\). Also \(e_j\) is supported on \(E_j=B_{t_{-}}U_j\), integrates to zero there, and the \(E_j\) are disjoint. Only the \(q\)-sample varies, and translation of the common bump against the constant density makes the diagonal divergences equal, with \[\chi^2(f_q^{(j)},f_q^+)\le C	heta^2h^d,\qquad \int_{D_q} rac{f_q^{(j)}(y)f_q^{(k)}(y)}{f_q^+(y)}\,dy=1\quad(j
e k).\] Consequently the fuzzy-null mixture satisfies \[\chi^2(\overline{\mathbb P}_{0,n},\mathbb P_n^+)= rac{[1+\chi^2(f_q^{(j)},f_q^+)]^{n_q}-1}{N}\le rac{\exp(Cn_q	heta^2h^d)-1}{N}.\] Choose \(h\asymp(\log n_\ast/n_\ast)^{1/(2s+d)}\) with its constant small enough that sample balance gives \(Cn_q	heta^2h^d\le	frac14\log N\). Then total variation tends to zero, and Le Cam's mixture inequality gives type-II error greater than \(0.20\) for every size-\(0.05\) test. Hence there is \(c>0\) such that \[ho_n^\ast\ge c\left( rac{\log n_\ast}{n_\ast}ight)^{s/(2s+d)}.\] This lower bound is independent of \(\mathrm{oeq:global	ext{-}endpoint	ext{-}response}\).
body.justification: The explicit transversal bump family verifies fixed support, class membership, null signs, and fuzzy-hypothesis indistinguishability before deriving the unconditional spatial logarithm.
body.gap: HutterRigollet2021MinimaxOT gives near-minimax integrated map risk through wavelet perturbations, not composite-null testing of a derivative-level global margin while preserving support and null geometry.
body.consumer: Counterfactual analysts obtain an unconditional impossibility threshold backed by a reproducible least-favorable family with fixed known supports.
